test_add_job: test the Queue.add_job and Queue.start_job methods for adding and processing jobs with deduplication
test_priority_logic_priority_order: test the Queue.start_job method respects priority ordering over creation order
test_queue_heartbeat: test the Queue.heartbeat method updates the last heartbeat timestamp for a running job
test_queue_get_zombies: test the Queue.get_zombies method identifies jobs without recent heartbeats
test_delete_dataset_waiting_jobs: test the Queue.delete_dataset_waiting_jobs method removes waiting jobs for a dataset while preserving started jobs
